attributes.title: New Orleans Dental Conference & LDA Annual Session 2027
attributes.series: New Orleans Dental Conference & LDA Annual Session
attributes.summary:
Attendees can earn up to 18 hours of CE across April 8 to 10, 2027, and the New Orleans Dental Association is an ADA CERP Recognized Provider. Louisiana dentists may also want to note that the meeting doubles as the state association's annual session.

Hygienists should check the "Of Interest To" line on each course, because not every session is marked for them. In the current draft, Mason's courses on April 9 and Arteaga's on April 10 are, while Goodacre's and Seibert's are not. The organizer says the course page is still in progress, so this can change.

Registration fees and the venue are not published yet for 2027.
